SHOW CAUSE NOTICE AND NOTICE OF PERSONAL HEARING

To:
The Managing Director / Factory In-Charge
M/s Pinnacle Fabrication Works (Unit 2)
Plot 88, Heavy Industrial Estate

Subject: Non-Compliance with Stack Emission Norms & Air Pollution Control

1. ALLEGATIONS & DEFECTS OBSERVED:
Pursuant to the surprise inspection conducted by the Board's scientific team on
October 08, 2026, particulate matter (PM10) emissions from Boiler #2 were recorded
at 285 mg/Nm3, exceeding the permissible limit of 150 mg/Nm3 established under
the State Air Conservation Standards.

2. WRITTEN EXPLANATION REQUIRED:
You are hereby directed to show cause in writing why consent to operate should
not be revoked under Section 31(A) of the Environmental Protection Framework.
WRITTEN SUBMISSION DEADLINE: October 29, 2026 (Within 14 calendar days).

3. NOTICE OF STATUTORY HEARING:
A formal personal hearing has been scheduled before the Member Secretary:
HEARING DATE & TIME: November 05, 2026 at 11:30 AM IST.
VENUE: Committee Room 'B', 3rd Floor, Paryavaran Bhawan (or via Video Conference).

4. MANDATORY ATTENDANCE:
Your designated technical head must appear in person or through an authorized
legal representative along with calibration logs of the Electrostatic Precipitator (ESP).
